pr.title: Include failure details in CI analysis issues
pr.author: JamesNK

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Cli.Tests, Cli, Cli, tests/Aspire.Cli.Tests/Aspire.Cli.Tests.cs... / Cli (windows-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: The failing test Aspire.Cli.Tests.Projects.AppHostServerSessionTests.Start_StopRequested_GracefulSignalerThrows_StillEscalatesToKill is a timing-sensitive process-escalation test in a file not touched by this PR (which only modifies analyze-ci-failure workflow/tooling files and TestTrxBuilder.cs). Other tests in the same class have prior flaky/timeout causes recorded, indicating this test family is timing-sensitive under CI load.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Cli.Tests, Cli, Cli, tests/Aspire.Cli.Tests/Aspire.Cli.Tests.cs... / Cli (macos-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: The failing test Aspire.Cli.Tests.Utils.EnvironmentCheckerTests.CheckAllAsync_TimedOutCheckReportsWarningAndContinues matches a known prior cause (cli-environmentchecker-timedout-flaky) where the timeout check completes too slowly under CI load, producing the wrong result object. The PR does not modify EnvironmentChecker or its tests.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: The E2E test timed out waiting for the pwa-msedge child debug session to attach to the Blazor WASM managed debugger. This is an environment/timing-related failure in the browser debugger E2E harness, and the PR does not touch any VS Code extension debugger code (it only changes analyze-ci-failure workflow/tooling and a CLI test project).
